Name: BBS Health Brand Identity
Project Overview:
I created the full brand identity and packaging system for BBS Health. The work covered the logo, colour palette, typography, visual style and brand guidelines. My goal was to build a clear and trustworthy wellness brand for the Australian market.

I designed labels for the complete product range. This included Menorelief, NRgy NAD+, Creatine Monohydrate and Total Biotic. Each product follows a consistent layout so customers can recognise the brand while still seeing the unique purpose of each supplement. The colours help separate the products and make it easier for shoppers to understand what they are buying.

The design keeps the information simple and clear. Key benefits are visible on the front of each pack and the typography is easy to read. We also created product imagery to support online listings and marketing content. This included clean studio photos and lifestyle shots that show the product in real use.

The result is a brand system that feels confident, modern and consistent across every product.
Post Summary: Brand identity and full label design for BBS Health. I created the logo, colour system, guidelines and packaging for their four hero products. The range includes Menorelief, NRgy NAD+, Creatine Monohydrate and Total Biotic.

Name: BODIE*Z Packaging Design
Project Overview:
I created a wide range of packaging concepts and product designs for BODIE*Z across their sports nutrition and hydration categories. The work included ready-to-drink cans, collagen lemonade, magnesium hydration powder, energy gels and protein water formats.

My focus was to build a clear visual structure that makes it easy for shoppers to identify each product, understand the benefits and recognise the brand on shelf. The designs use bold colours, strong typography and simple icons to highlight key details such as protein content, calories, electrolytes and functional benefits. Each product flavour has its own look while still sitting inside one consistent system.

I developed multiple concepts for new product lines, including Shaker’Z hydration powder, the full gel range (Electrolyte, Glutathione, Pre Workout, Isotonic and Recovery) and packaging treatments for cans and pouch formats. This involved creating layout options, colour directions, benefit callouts and visual ideas to help the team explore new directions for the brand.

The result is a collection of packaging that show the breadth of the brand and support BODIE*Z as they expand their product range.

‍
Post Summary: Packaging concepts and product design created for BODIE*Z. I worked across multiple product lines, including ready-to-drink cans, hydration powders, energy gels and protein powder formats. The work covered flavour systems, icon sets, colour structure and front-of-pack layouts.

Name: SmileSip Brand Identity & Websit
Project Overview:
I created the brand identity and packaging for SmileSip, a pH-neutral oral health drink mix made to support everyday dental care. My work included the logo, colour palette, typography, flavour system, icons and the full packaging design.

My goal was to build a brand that feels fresh, credible and easy to understand. I shaped the visual direction around clarity and daily use. Each flavour has its own colour while still fitting into one unified system. The label layout keeps all key details readable so shoppers can understand the benefits at a glance.

I designed the packaging for individual pouches and the wider flavour range. The style works across print, social media, the website and retail displays. I also created supporting visuals used through their digital presence, helping the brand extend into education and daily oral care habits.

This project established the core identity that SmileSip now uses across all channels, giving the brand a strong and consistent foundation as it grows.

‍
Post Summary: Brand identity and packaging created for SmileSip. I designed the logo, colour system, flavour range, icons and the full visual style for this oral health drink mix. The work covers product packaging, digital assets and the look and feel used across their website and marketing.
